$comment: How much each gate looked at, last time it passed. A FALL fails `run-all-gates`: a walk that covers fewer subjects than before is the failure that prints a tick. Re-record with --record when the drop is intended and say why in the commit.
$measuredBy: a full run of every gate; `e2e:demo-contrast` counts PAGES walked, not rows measured — the row count moves with network timing and is not a coverage figure
